name: Takatsuki Mei
source:
She is kind and honest.  She has a weak temperment that prevents her from disobeying her mother. 

She does not understand Ryosuke's cruel behavior, but she listens to him out of love for him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28722]Getchu[/url]]
